page.overview:
Who is Building Snake?

Building Snake is one of the Senior Officers and the navigator of the Red Hair Pirates.

Snake is a tall and muscular man with long, dark gray hair. He possesses two dragon tattoos: a smaller one on his right forearm and a larger one on the right side of his chest. He wears black sunglasses and a white coat, as well as a sky-blue sash around his waist.

Twelve years ago, he was smaller in stature, had shorter, light brown hair and wore orange sunglasses instead. He already had the smaller dragon tattoo on his right forearm.

Snake is a Senior Officer of the Red Hair Pirates, giving him authority over lower-ranking members of the crew. Snake is a powerful individual himself, considering how Marine Commodore Brannew described the whole crew as having a high average of bounties.
